CREATE TRIGGER CDN.PodNag_DeleteHandler ON CDN.PodNag FOR DELETE AS SET NOCOUNT ON
-- obsługa kaskadowego kasowania wierszy z tabeli CDN.PodElemDok IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.PodElemDok, deleted WHERE deleted.PON_GIDNumer = CDN.PodElemDok.PED_PONNumer AND (deleted.PON_GIDTyp in (7714)) ) DELETE CDN.PodElemDok FROM CDN.PodElemDok, deleted WHERE deleted.PON_GIDNumer = CDN.PodElemDok.PED_PONNumer AND (deleted.PON_GIDTyp in (7714))
